rich_text.plain_text: Summary

text.content: The module project moves from a three-node canvas that answers a question to an agent that retrieves from the firm's own material, routes by intent, checks live data, waits for a human before acting, and refuses the questions that are not its job. Sprint 4 was where it stopped being a build and started being something you can put in front of a stakeholder.
